research_brief.research_summary: A log ladder downward in metres: sand grain, hair (edge of naked-eye vision), red blood cell, virus (below the light-microscope limit), atom, proton; then electrons with no measured size and the Planck length as a hypothesis, not a proven floor.

data_points.claim: Sand grain: about 0.06-2 mm by geologists' definition; 'about half a millimetre' is a typical medium grain. MEASURED (typical) [SAND]
Human hair diameter ranges widely (~17-180 um); ~70 um typical. 'A tenth of a sand grain'. MEASURED (typical) [HAIR]
Naked-eye limit: ~0.04 mm (fine hair) just distinguishable by good eyes; commonly rounded to ~0.1 mm. PROBABLY (varies by eye and light) [EYE]
Red blood cell diameter ~7-8 um, about ten times narrower than a hair. MEASURED [CELL]
Most viruses ~20-300 nm; influenza ~100 nm, about 75x smaller than a red cell. MEASURED [VIRUS]
Light-microscope resolution limit ~200 nm (Abbe diffraction limit); most viruses are below it. MEASURED [LIMIT]
Atom diameter ~0.1-0.3 nm (hydrogen ~0.1 nm), about a thousand times smaller than a virus. MEASURED [ATOM]
Proton charge radius 0.8414 fm (CODATA 2018); diameter ~1.7 fm, ~60,000x smaller than a hydrogen atom. MEASURED [PROTON]
Electron: no measured size; experiments bound it below ~1e-18 m; consistent with a point particle. MEASURED (upper bound) [ELECTRON]
Planck length ~1.6e-35 m, built from c, G and hbar; the scale where gravity is expected to need quantum treatment. It is NOT proven to be the smallest possible length. MAYBE [PLANCK]
1.6e-35 m written out has 34 zeros after the decimal point; proton (~1e-15 m) to Planck is ~20 more powers of ten. MEASURED (arithmetic) [ZEROS]

common_questions: What is the smallest thing that exists?

misconceptions.myth: The Planck length is the proven pixel size of the universe
misconceptions.reality: It is the scale where gravity is expected to need a quantum theory; no experiment shows space is pixelated there.

misconceptions.myth: Electrons are tiny balls with a known radius
misconceptions.reality: No size has been measured; experiments only bound it below ~1e-18 m.

angles_discovered.name: Count the zeros
angles_discovered.hook: Every step down adds zeros after the decimal point; the last step adds twenty.

angles_discovered.name: Where seeing stops
angles_discovered.hook: Your eye gives up at a hair; light itself gives up at a virus.
angles_discovered.why_now: two honest instrument limits on the way down

angles_discovered.name: No floor yet
angles_discovered.hook: Electrons have no size we can find, and the Planck length is a guess at a floor.
